name: agentswitch
description: AgentSwitch - continuity layer for coding-agent CLIs (Milestone 1: simulated adapters)

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @agentswitch/contracts && npm run build -w @agentswitch/crypto && npm run build -w @agentswitch/relay-core && npm run build -w @agentswitch/worker-core
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @agentswitch/control-plane && npm run build -w @agentswitch/worker && npm run build -w @agentswitch/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/control-plane/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
